prophecies.title: The seed of the woman will bruise the serpent's head
prophecies.note: The first promise: a son of a woman who would destroy sin's power, himself wounded in doing it. He destroyed sin and death in himself at his first coming, does so for his followers at his return, and for the whole world at the end of the thousand years.

fulfilments.note: "Made of a woman."
In himself: through death he destroyed him that had the power of death.
The believers share the seed's victory: God would shortly crush the adversaries troubling the ecclesia at Rome (16:17-18) under their feet.
For his followers: changed in a moment, mortality put on immortality, death swallowed up in victory.
For the whole world: the last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
No more sea, no more flesh: all changed from terrestrial to celestial bodies, and no more death.

prophecies.title: In Abram all families of the earth will be blessed

fulfilments.note: Paul calls it the gospel preached beforehand to Abraham.

prophecies.title: The land given to Abram and to his seed for ever
prophecies.note: Abraham never received the land himself (Acts 7:5; Hebrews 11:13): the promise waits for the resurrection and the kingdom.

fulfilments.note: "And to thy seed, which is Christ."
Heir of the world.

prophecies.title: Abram's seed as the stars; the covenant of the land
Abraham the father of many nations; an everlasting covenant
The oath: in Abraham's seed all nations will be blessed

fulfilments.note: "The oath which he sware to our father Abraham."

prophecies.title: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah

fulfilments.note: Our Lord sprang out of Judah.
The Lion of the tribe of Judah.

prophecies.title: A star out of Jacob, a sceptre out of Israel
A prophet like Moses
David's son will reign on his throne for ever
prophecies.note: The son is raised up from David's own descendants; God will be his father and he God's son, and his throne established for ever.

fulfilments.note: Solomon on David's throne, building the house: the promise's first, partial fulfilment.
"The Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David."

prophecies.title: The LORD's anointed king and son

fulfilments.note: Applied to the resurrection.

prophecies.title: The son of man, a little lower than the angels, with all things under his feet

fulfilments.note: Then the Son himself is subject to the Father, that God may be all in all (1 Corinthians 15:28).

prophecies.title: Thou wilt not leave my soul in the grave

fulfilments.note: Peter: David died and was buried; he spoke of the resurrection of Christ.

prophecies.title: My God, why hast thou forsaken me?
He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken
Lo, I come to do thy will
Mine own familiar friend hath lifted up his heel against me
Thy throne is for ever: the king anointed above his fellows
prophecies.note: Addressed to the king of David's line at his wedding. Elohim is used of human rulers and judges elsewhere (Psalm 82:6; John 10:34-35).

prophecies.title: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast received gifts for men
The zeal of thine house; in my thirst they gave me vinegar
The king's righteous dominion from sea to sea
David's seed will endure for ever, his throne as the sun

fulfilments.note: The first begotten, the prince of the kings of the earth; the faithful witness (89:37).

prophecies.title: Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool

fulfilments.note: He reigns until every enemy is subdued, then delivers up the kingdom to God (1 Corinthians 15:24-25).

prophecies.title: A priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek
The stone which the builders refused

fulfilments.note: Their house was left desolate in AD 70 (23:38); Jerusalem will welcome him when he returns.

prophecies.title: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne

fulfilments.note: A horn of salvation in the house of David.

prophecies.title: The mountain of the LORD's house; swords into plowshares
A virgin shall conceive and bear a son, Immanuel
prophecies.note: A sign to Ahaz and the house of David in their own day (7:16; 8:3-4), fulfilled fully in Jesus. Immanuel is a name, "God with us", as Matthew explains it.

fulfilments.note: A son born in Ahaz's day; before he could speak, Damascus and Samaria were spoiled (7:16).

prophecies.title: A stone of stumbling and a rock of offence
Galilee of the nations sees a great light
Unto us a son is given: the throne of David without end
prophecies.note: A child born and a son given, whose government is on the throne of David for ever; the names describe what God would do through him.

prophecies.title: A rod out of the stem of Jesse
prophecies.note: The Spirit rests on him (11:2); he judges the earth, and the wolf dwells with the lamb (11:4-9).

fulfilments.note: The root of David.

prophecies.title: He will swallow up death in victory
A tried stone, a precious corner stone, laid in Zion
A king shall reign in righteousness
The desert shall blossom; the eyes of the blind opened
prophecies.note: Jesus' healings were a foretaste (Matthew 11:5) of the land's restoration in the kingdom.

prophecies.title: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness
Behold my servant, whom I uphold
A light to the Gentiles, salvation to the end of the earth
I gave my back to the smiters
The suffering servant, wounded for our transgressions

fulfilments.note: With the rich in his death.

prophecies.title: The sure mercies of David

fulfilments.note: Paul ties the promise to David to the resurrection.

prophecies.title: The Redeemer shall come to Zion
The Spirit of the Lord is upon me: good tidings to the meek
prophecies.note: Jesus stopped reading before "the day of vengeance of our God" (61:2): that day came in AD 70 (Luke 21:22).

fulfilments.note: "These be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled."

prophecies.title: New heavens and a new earth; the wolf and the lamb feed together
A seething pot out of the north: evil breaks forth on Jerusalem
prophecies.note: The families of the kingdoms of the north set their thrones at Jerusalem's gates: Babylon.

prophecies.title: The whirlwind out of the north: the glory of the LORD comes in judgment
prophecies.note: The cherubim come "out of the north" (1:4) as Babylon did; the glory leaves the temple and the city (10:18-19; 11:23) before Jerusalem falls.

prophecies.title: A righteous Branch raised unto David
A new covenant with the house of Israel
David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne
Remove the diadem, until he come whose right it is
prophecies.note: Spoken against Zedekiah, the last king of David's line to reign in Jerusalem: the throne is overturned until its rightful king comes.

fulfilments.note: Zedekiah blinded and taken to Babylon: the last of David's line to reign in Jerusalem.

prophecies.title: One shepherd over them, my servant David
One nation in the land, and one king over them all
The stone cut out without hands: a kingdom that shall never be destroyed

fulfilments.note: The stone falls on the husbandmen who rejected it: the judgment of AD 70 (Luke 20:16).

prophecies.title: One like the son of man comes with the clouds of heaven
prophecies.note: The son of man comes to the Ancient of Days to receive the kingdom: his ascension. Caiaphas's generation saw it shown in the judgment of AD 70 (Matthew 24:30; 26:64); the saints receive the kingdom at his return (7:18-27).

fulfilments.note: Taken up in a cloud: the son of man comes to the Ancient of Days.

prophecies.title: The saints of the most High shall take the kingdom

fulfilments.note: "We shall reign on the earth."

prophecies.title: Seventy weeks: Messiah the Prince cut off
prophecies.note: Messiah is cut off (9:26) at the cross; the people of the prince that shall come destroy the city and the sanctuary: the Romans in AD 70, the abomination Jesus warned of (Matthew 24:15; Luke 21:20).

fulfilments.note: Jerusalem compassed with armies.

prophecies.title: Many that sleep in the dust shall awake

fulfilments.note: "Great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world."

prophecies.title: Many days without a king, then they shall seek David their king
Out of Egypt have I called my son
prophecies.note: Israel's exodus as the pattern for God's son.

prophecies.title: I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh
prophecies.note: Poured out at Pentecost; the great and terrible day that followed was the judgment of AD 70, from which those who called on the name were saved (Acts 2:40).

prophecies.title: I will raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen
The law shall go forth of Zion; the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion
Out of Bethlehem shall come a ruler in Israel
prophecies.note: His "goings forth" are from of old: the ruler's line runs back to David of Bethlehem.

prophecies.title: I raise up the Chaldeans: a work in your days
prophecies.note: Spoken of Babylon; Paul warned his hearers that the same work would come in their own days, as it did in AD 70.

prophecies.title: I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come

fulfilments.note: "Yet once more": the shaking that removed the old order in AD 70, while the kingdom that cannot be moved is received.

prophecies.title: The Branch shall be a priest upon his throne
Thy King cometh, lowly, riding upon an ass
prophecies.note: The entry into Jerusalem fulfilled 9:9; his dominion from sea to sea (9:10) is still to come.

prophecies.title: Thirty pieces of silver cast to the potter
prophecies.note: Matthew names Jeremiah, who also bought a field (Jeremiah 32:6-9) and went to the potter (Jeremiah 18-19).

prophecies.title: They shall look upon me whom they have pierced
Smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered
His feet shall stand upon the mount of Olives; the LORD king over all the earth

fulfilments.note: He left from the mount of Olives and will come again in like manner.

prophecies.title: I will send my messenger before me
The Sun of righteousness shall arise with healing in his wings
prophecies.note: The day that burns as an oven, which John the Baptist announced (Matthew 3:10-12), came on Jerusalem in AD 70.

prophecies.title: Elijah the prophet before the great and dreadful day
prophecies.note: John the Baptist was the Elijah (Matthew 11:14; 17:12-13); the great and dreadful day he went before was AD 70.

fulfilments.note: "Elias is come already": John the Baptist (17:12-13).

prophecies.title: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of the most high God
The passover lamb: neither shall ye break a bone thereof

fulfilments.note: Christ our passover.

prophecies.title: The serpent of brass lifted up on a pole
Three days and three nights in the belly of the fish
Abram's seed afflicted four hundred years, then brought out with great substance
Scattered among the heathen, yet not cast away
prophecies.note: God will remember his covenant with Jacob, Isaac and Abraham, and remember the land (26:42).

fulfilments.note: The land enjoyed her sabbaths.

prophecies.title: A nation from far, swift as the eagle; then scattered among all people
prophecies.note: The siege and its famine came on Jerusalem twice: under Babylon (Lamentations 4:10) and under Rome; the scattering that followed AD 70 reached every nation.

prophecies.title: Gathered again from all the nations into the land
prophecies.note: Fulfilled first in the return from Babylon, and again in the regathering of Israel before Christ's return.

fulfilments.note: Nehemiah pleads it at the return from Babylon.

prophecies.title: The sword shall never depart from David's house
Ahijah tears the garment: ten tribes given to Jeroboam
A child named Josiah will burn the priests' bones on Bethel's altar
Babylon overthrown by the Medes, never to be inhabited
Egypt and Assyria blessed with Israel
Cyrus named as the shepherd who will rebuild Jerusalem
prophecies.note: Named about a century and a half before he reigned.

prophecies.title: Seventy years of serving the king of Babylon
Israel shall not cease from being a nation before me for ever
Tyre made like the top of a rock, a place to spread nets
prophecies.note: Fulfilled in stages: Nebuchadnezzar's siege, then Alexander's causeway of the old city's rubble (332 BC).

prophecies.title: Egypt the basest of the kingdoms
I will take you from among the heathen and bring you into your own land

fulfilments.note: The first return, from Babylon.

prophecies.title: The valley of dry bones: the whole house of Israel brought back to life

fulfilments.note: The first return, from Babylon.

prophecies.title: Gog of the land of Magog invades the restored land
prophecies.note: Gog is the northern power, Russia, invading the restored land at Christ's return, and destroyed on the mountains of Israel. The name returns for the uprising after the thousand years (Revelation 20:8).

fulfilments.note: After the thousand years the name returns for the last uprising against the camp of the saints.

prophecies.title: The image of four metals: four kingdoms
prophecies.note: Commonly read as Babylon, Medo-Persia, Greece and Rome; the feet of iron and clay as the divided kingdoms that follow.

prophecies.title: Four great beasts out of the sea
prophecies.note: The same four kingdoms as Daniel 2. Readings of the little horn (7:8) differ.

prophecies.title: The ram and the he-goat: Media and Persia, and Greece
prophecies.note: Named in the chapter itself (8:20-21); the great horn broken is Alexander, and the four horns his successors' kingdoms.

prophecies.title: The kings of the north and of the south
prophecies.note: Traced in detail through the Persian kings, Alexander and the Ptolemies and Seleucids to Antiochus Epiphanes.

prophecies.title: The house of Esau for stubble; the kingdom shall be the LORD's
Zion shall be plowed as a field

fulfilments.note: Remembered a century later, when Jeremiah was on trial.
"They shall not leave in thee one stone upon another."

prophecies.title: The fall of Nineveh
prophecies.note: Nineveh fell to the Babylonians and Medes in 612 BC.

prophecies.title: Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people
Hear ye indeed, but understand not
prophecies.note: Quoted of those who heard Jesus' parables and Paul's preaching without understanding.

fulfilments.note: "These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory."

prophecies.title: Rachel weeping for her children
prophecies.note: Rachel mourned the exiles at Ramah; Matthew hears her again at Bethlehem.

fulfilments.note: The exiles gathered in chains at Ramah.

prophecies.title: I will open my mouth in a parable

patterns.title: Invasions from the north
patterns.note: Jerusalem is overrun from the north three times: by Babylon, by Rome, and by Gog at Christ's return. Each prophecy was spoken first for its hearers' own day and echoes forward to the last invasion; after the thousand years a final Gog rises and is destroyed, and Christ delivers up the kingdom to the Father.
